mintAuthority.summary: cgUSD is a direct-deployed rebasing token on Base: its native mint(address,uint256) path takes the configured USDC asset, while issuer docs describe Axelar-assisted deposits from other chains. Cygnus controls the off-chain Treasury investment path and oracle-reported NAV rebase. The token and accounting oracle share a TimelockController owner with a 10-second delay and a 2-of-11 Safe proposer.

review.evidence: At Base block 47199109: cgUSD vault owner() = TimelockController 0xfECAB866; accounting oracle owner() = same; TimelockController minDelay = 10s; PROPOSER_ROLE = 2/11 Safe (0x188f3264, getOwners returns 11, getThreshold = 2); EXECUTOR_ROLE held by 4 contracts; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE self-held; no modules on the Safe proposer or the timelock. All mint-capable controls confirmed from chain state. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the 2/11 Safe controls mint and NAV authority through an effectively immediate 10-second timelock, while no dated, itemized whole-supply reconciliation artefact or prudential authorization is evidenced. Sol reconciliation adjudication (2026-08-15): Cygnus's wiki describes synchronizing total cgUSD issuance with the NAV of on-chain stablecoins, U.S. Treasury bills, and accrued interest every New York banking day, but it is an undated procedure description rather than an actually published recurring report. Searches of the issuer's cgUSD documentation and website found no dated NAV statement, issuance-to-reserve reconciliation, reserve report, or itemized composition dashboard, so periodic reconciliation remains unevidenced. Source-scoped correction in a source review on 2026-10-20: the reviewed sources do not positively establish absence of supervision or an exact cgUSD prudential mandate; supervision is unknown rather than none. Current overview, NAV procedure, withdrawal FAQ and Interface Terms still provide no complete dated recurring liability-to-backing reconciliation. Base block 52872668 (0x9b5c797ecc4650379bd143f643165265312188f8777df74c603ee159ff75a898, 2026-10-20T22:18:03Z) reconfirms the common token/oracle owner and 10-second minimum delay. No independent assurance or favorable process rung is inferred; the original review start and control pins are unchanged.
